name: mediaviewer
description: Windows viewer for a real camera dump - photos and video in one folder.
$comment-baseline: Pinned. plan/09: reproducible builds beat fresh deps. Move it deliberately, in its own commit, with the frame-time suite re-run afterwards.
$comment-dependencies: PR 1 needs imgui (present lab + F3 overlay) and catch2 (core tests) only.
The full v1 set from plan/09 is in $comment-v1-pending below, with the PR
that introduces each entry. They are added when their PR lands, not before:
a manifest that pulls ffmpeg and libheif on day one costs an hour of vcpkg
build per clean clone, to compile a window that clears to a colour.
imgui takes dx11-binding and NOT win32-binding. That backend mutates
ImGuiIO from inside the window procedure, which would put the UI thread
inside the render thread's ImGui context. src/shell/input_state.h feeds
ImGui from the published snapshot instead - plan/02 threading model.

$comment-v1-pending.PR 17 (osx): landed: permissive still codecs use the default arm64-osx triplet in this manifest. LGPL libheif[core], libde265, libraw and ffmpeg use tools/mac/dependencies/vcpkg.json with arm64-osx-dynamic and a separate install root. See RELEASING.md; do not add the LGPL codecs to this manifest's osx dependencies.
$comment-v1-pending.PR 18 (osx, folded-in PR 4): landed: sqlite3 on osx -- JPEG-512 thumbnail cache (image/thumb_mac.cpp), same spec jpg512.1 and schema as Windows (plan/12 2026-09-17).
$comment-v1-pending.PR 4: landed: sqlite3. JPEG-512 thumbs in the island; DirectXTex/BC7 waits until a thumb must be GPU-resident (plan/12 2026-09-07).
$comment-v1-pending.PR 5a: landed: ffmpeg. NOTE the feature names here are the port's, not the plan's shorthand: `core` and `avutil` are NOT features of ffmpeg (avutil is always built), and passing them fails vcpkg outright. avfilter is required for PR 5c's atempo chain; dav1d is the AV1 software fallback (BSD-2, LGPL-compatible) for GPUs without an AV1 profile.
$comment-v1-pending.PR 6: landed: giflib (MIT) and libwebp (BSD-3, default features: libwebpmux is used by tests only) for animated GIF / WebP, brought forward from PR 7 (plan/12 2026-09-13).
$comment-v1-pending.PR 7: landed: tiff, libheif (default-features OFF — the port's `hevc` feature is x265 encode, forbidden), libavif[dav1d], libraw, crashpad. libde265 is a hard dependency of libheif, not a feature, so HEIC decode does not pull x265. See plan/12 2026-09-13.
$comment-v1-pending.PR 9: exiv2[bmff,png,xmp] (windows; built and tested there, plan/12 2026-09-24). macOS installs it dynamically from tools/mac/dependencies/vcpkg.json instead.
$comment-v1-pending.note-ffmpeg: LGPL only. No --enable-gpl, no --enable-nonfree, no x264/x265, no LibRaw GPL demosaic pack. tools/licence-check.ps1 fails the build on any of them, and it now reads the configure string embedded in the built avutil/avcodec DLLs rather than a log vcpkg deletes. Verified on the pinned baseline: the port configures --enable-d3d11va --enable-dxva2 --enable-shared with --disable-libx264 --disable-libx265 --disable-libfdk-aac and no --enable-gpl.
$comment-v1-pending.note-exiv2: GPL-2.0, and kept. The app is GPL-2.0-or-later (plan/11, settled in PR 1), so this is compliant rather than a trap.
$comment-v1-pending.note-v1.1: libjxl, openexr, openjpeg and resvg arrive with their formats in v1.1 (D5). Do not add one to buy a format early.

$comment-overrides: Empty by design. Pin a specific port here only with a written reason; the baseline is the pin.
